# guard-family-health-signals

> Emails related to the baby, family health, nanny search, fertility clinic, or medical appointments get elevated immediately — these are non-negotiable priorities.

## Trigger and action

**When:** Fires when an email involves medical providers, childcare services, fertility/health clinics, or family health matters.
**Then:** Route to priority triage with family-context flag; for childcare/medical scheduling, create an errand to confirm or act.

## Rationale

The 'New Parent Compression' pattern is the most emotionally significant in the dataset. Eszter is on GYED with an infant, they're actively searching for a full-time nanny through HappyMammy, and Krio Intézet invoices suggest ongoing fertility treatment or cryopreservation management. David has a personal medical appointment at Szent Magdolna for June 2. The 'Support our Baby Fund' on Gumroad confirms the family is in active new-parent mode.

Meanwhile David is working nearly half-weekends (0.427 weekend activity ratio), managing construction at home, and buying a second property. The risk of a missed medical appointment, an overlooked nanny agency response, or a delayed fertility clinic follow-up is real and high-consequence. These aren't things that can be batched for the evening digest.

The 'Screenless Dad' philosophy David writes about — being present, reducing digital distraction — is directly tested by how his AI butler handles family health signals. If Alfred buries a HappyMammy callback confirmation under 40 GitHub CI notifications, the system has failed at its most basic purpose.
